Design: no anti-repetition prompts/filters, no forced novel topics, no mandatory speaking, natural action-contingent floor, epistemic uncertainty, individual relationships/memory, nonsecret evidence. User explicitly wants human-like conversation mechanisms.

Phase 0A immutable offline snapshot, no production token/relay in experimental runner, 200 manually labelled episodes, double annotate, full validator inventory, source IDs; Phase 0B pinned 1B single-action realization test 100 examples three seeds; ablate system-injected topic terms and ensure output appropriate, do not reward sheer novelty.

Phase 1 (before floor) silence heartbeat with last_healthy_beat_at vs last_public_message_at, beat ledger, Git commit atomic across JSON files, stable idempotency, Allen ACK only after durable acceptance, relay at-least-once dedupe, push race and fault injection, backward-compatible state migrations. Silent beats advance runtime health only, not public speech. Workflow GitHub runner/watchdog must use appropriate health signal; no endless Git write storms.

Phase 2 remove mandatory_speech + Distinct contribution + novelty validation in experimental code, preserve privacy/security and malformed speech rejection. Allow short acknowledgment and purposeful exact repeats. Separate speaker utterance terms from system topic labels. Test end-to-end validation chain, negative controls.

Phase 4 select floor BEFORE generating expression, per-person willingness/bids, directed question gets next conversational opportunity but no obligation; group invitation, silence, two consecutive same speaker, no arbitrary speaker quotas; true selected expression only, per-observer read/witness history; default off flag and shadow comparison.

Phase 5 per-person common ground, third-position repair, source-linked episodic memory, no global truth promotion, individual private beliefs. Phase 6 phased A/B with matched seeds/multiple events and model pinned, blind primary action-relevance and repair metrics, lexical concentration secondary, canary then rollback.
